title: Token Expiry & Reauthentication UX
boundary: Local metadata-only UX state. It describes expired connections, affected capabilities, explicit reauthentication, safe capability-scoped retry, explicit revoke, and preserved local data. It performs no provider request, credential access, local scan, or data deletion; provider, credential, hosted CI, signing, telemetry, hardware, adoption, and publication remain DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
